title: [BUG] New+ menu hasn't been working on Win11 with classic context menu enabled for several versions (Currently not working in v0.99.1)
author: futuremotiondev

judgment.rationale: The original reporter says formatting Windows 11 resolved their instance. The remaining Nilesoft Shell comment is not enough to establish an independently reproducible PowerToys bug and overlaps the active classic-context-menu compatibility tracker #48512.
evidence: The original report says New+ disappeared after the classic context menu was enabled.
The reporter confirmed on 2026-09-04 that formatting Windows 11 resolved the problem.
A commenter reports a related Nilesoft Shell context-menu case.
Open issue #48512 specifically tracks New+ compatibility with the Windows 11 classic context menu.
The existing classic New+ handler has Windows-version-specific behavior, making a separate generic fix plan unsafe.
judgment.recommended_action: Link the canonical classic-context-menu tracker and close this reporter-resolved instance; collect any reproducible Nilesoft-specific evidence in the canonical issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: The original instance is reporter-confirmed resolved and #48512 is the active public tracker for the remaining classic-menu compatibility scope.

issue_context.summary: New+ was missing from a Windows 11 classic context menu, but the original reporter now says the issue resolved after formatting Windows. A later Nilesoft Shell observation remains unverified.
known_information: The report targets 0.99.1 and includes a public diagnostic archive.
The original reporter confirmed resolution after formatting Windows.
A later comment mentions Nilesoft Shell.
Issue #48512 remains open for New+ classic-menu compatibility.
inferences: The original instance may have involved machine-specific shell registration or configuration state.
The Nilesoft observation may be related but does not prove the same defect or a supported integration.
issue_context.analysis: The latest reporter result makes independent remediation inappropriate. Consolidation preserves the potentially useful Nilesoft observation without creating a competing New+ workstream.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue and both comments.
Read open issue #48512 and compared its classic-menu scope.
Reviewed the existing artifact's cited classic-handler behavior and retained only public decision evidence.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that formatting Windows resolved the original instance. The remaining Windows 11 classic-context-menu compatibility work is tracked in #48512: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/48512. Please add any currently reproducible details there, including the Nilesoft Shell case and the exact PowerToys/Windows versions, so that classic-menu investigation remains consolidated.
